title: Qamar Bay Resident FAQ

records.question: When is rubbish collected?
records.answer: General waste is collected every day at 07:00. Recycling is collected on Sundays and Wednesdays.

records.question: How do I book the service lift for moving in or out?
records.answer: Book the service lift in the app at least 48 hours ahead. Moving is allowed between 08:00 and 18:00.

records.question: What does a replacement access card cost?
records.answer: A lost or damaged access card is replaced for 100 SAR at the management office.

records.question: Where do I collect parcels?
records.answer: Parcels are held at the concierge desk in the clubhouse for up to 7 days.

records.question: Can I install a satellite dish on my balcony?
records.answer: No. Satellite dishes are not allowed on balconies or façades. A shared satellite feed is provided in every unit.
